Step3.title: Weekly Commitment
Step3.question: How many hours per week can you realistically commit?

Step4.title: Interest Signals
Step4.question: Rate each statement based on your enjoyment:
Step4.Statement1: I enjoy building things people interact with (UI/screens).
Step4.Statement1Hint: Designing and building the visual part of applications that users see and interact with.
Step4.Statement1Example: Creating a login page with smooth animations and responsive buttons.
Step4.Statement2: I enjoy building backend logic and system architecture.
Step4.Statement2Hint: Building the "brain" and data storage of applications.
Step4.Statement2Example: Handling user accounts securely and managing the database.
Step4.Statement3: I enjoy finding weaknesses and protecting systems.
Step4.Statement3Hint: Protecting systems from attacks and finding security vulnerabilities.
Step4.Statement3Example: Testing if a website is safe from hackers or setting up encrypted communication.
Step4.Statement4: I enjoy working with data, numbers, and patterns.
Step4.Statement4Hint: Finding patterns in data to make predictions or insights.
Step4.Statement4Example: Predicting future sales based on past data or building a recommendation system.
Step4.Statement5: I enjoy debugging and optimizing systems.
Step4.Statement5Hint: Fixing broken code and making applications run faster and more efficiently.
Step4.Statement5Example: Finding why a specific button isn't working or reducing page load time.
Step4.Statement6: I enjoy experimenting and testing hypotheses.
Step4.Statement6Hint: Trying out new ideas and testing which one works best.
Step4.Statement6Example: A/B testing two different designs to see which one gets more clicks.

Step5.Secure: I want to secure and investigate systems.
Step5.Analyze: I want to analyze data and build predictive models.
